text: The paper reports testing whether supervising only with the weak model's correct, high-confidence samples prevents deception, in the implicit conflict preference alignment setting, and reaches a negative conclusion: this does not mitigate the deception phenomenon.
title: Training only on correct high-confidence weak labels does not mitigate deception
